topics.title: Foundations, duality and optimality
topics.supports: LP/QP formulations, weak and strong duality, KKT conditions and the distinction between a feasible point and a proof of optimality.
topics.status: Core mathematical reference; citations do not certify the implementation.

topics.title: Revised simplex and basis updates
topics.supports: Primal/dual revised simplex, bounded variables, hyper-sparse pivots and reusable basis representations.
topics.status: Current LP and node-relaxation work. Parallel simplex is a research direction, not an implemented claim.

topics.title: Sparse linear algebra and preconditioning
topics.supports: Sparse products, LU fill, triangular solves, Krylov methods and preconditioners for the LP and QP engines.
topics.status: Algorithmic study only: external numerical packages are not proposed as replacements for the from-scratch core.

topics.title: Numerical stability and trustworthy certificates
topics.supports: Scaling, residual checks, iterative refinement, safe pruning and exact-versus-tolerance-based verification.
topics.status: General exact rational solving and verified cut certificates are future work; restricted exact binary checks do not establish general exactness.

topics.title: Presolve and domain propagation
topics.supports: Bound tightening, substitution, formulation strengthening, postsolve reconstruction and safe parallel reductions.
topics.status: Includes both current propagation and possible stronger presolve; record each transformation and reconstruct the original model.

topics.title: Branch-and-bound and search strategies
topics.supports: Relaxation bounds, reliability branching, node selection, conflict reasoning and modular solver architecture.
topics.status: SCIP literature is architecture and algorithm background, not permission to embed its solver core.

topics.title: Cutting planes and cut management
topics.supports: Gomory/MIR, cover inequalities, cut validity, numerical safety and the tradeoff between stronger bounds and harder LPs.
topics.status: The source repo's iteration 37 demoted Gomory cuts after end-to-end regressions; literature is not evidence to re-enable them.

topics.title: Primal heuristics and neighborhood search
topics.supports: Feasibility pumps, diving, rounding, repair and budgeted neighborhood searches for early feasible incumbents.
topics.status: A heuristic incumbent must pass original-model validation and does not prove optimality.

topics.title: Convex QP and operator splitting
topics.supports: ADMM, projected/proximal methods, semidefinite Hessians and primal/dual stopping conditions.
topics.status: Continuous convex QP is the relevant scope; MIQP, nonconvex QP and nonlinear constraints require additional algorithms.

topics.title: Large-scale first-order and interior-point methods
topics.supports: PDHG restarts, interior-point systems and infeasibility detection for large sparse continuous models.
topics.status: PDLP and a general interior-point engine are research directions, not existing HyperGrey capabilities.

topics.title: GPU and multicore optimization
topics.supports: GPU-friendly sparse operations, transfer overhead, parallel algorithm structure and CPU/GPU comparisons.
topics.status: Existing GPU measurements cover box-constrained convex QP. They do not establish accelerated general LP or MILP.

topics.title: Benchmark libraries and input formats
topics.supports: MIPLIB, Netlib, QPLIB and Mittelmann provenance; precise MPS/QPLIB semantics and problem-class filtering.
topics.status: Library membership does not mean a model is supported or has been solved. Preserve input and reference-solution versions.

topics.title: Evaluation and reproducibility
topics.supports: Performance profiles, full failure accounting, fair stopping criteria, repeated runs and progress over time.
topics.status: Project speed and robustness claims must come from dated local experiments, not the external papers' results.

topics.title: Refinery planning, crude blending and process scheduling
topics.supports: MRPL context, refinery material/quality balances, time-dependent scheduling and boundaries between LP/MILP and MINLP.
topics.status: MARCO is a teaching/literature case, not MRPL plant data. Nonlinear blending papers motivate extensions and engineering review.

topics.title: Production, logistics and power applications
topics.supports: Transportation, lot sizing, supply-chain scheduling, economic dispatch and unit commitment as solver use cases.
topics.status: Check convexity and linearization explicitly; AC OPF and full industrial scheduling are not automatically LP/MILP/convex-QP problems.
